item.question: Why might aggregation be suitable when only average effects are considered in simulation studies?
item.answer: Aggregation is suitable when only average effects are considered because it simplifies analysis by focusing on overall trends rather than individual variations or interactions that may require more complex modeling approaches like those offered by multilevel frameworks.
